title: Unsupervised learning overshadowed by supervised learning
description: Unsupervised learning has been overshadowed by the successes of purely supervised learning, yet is expected to become far more important. Human and animal learning is largely unsupervised, discovering structure by observation rather than being told labels.
canonical_description: unsupervised learning underdeveloped relative to supervised learning and needs further progress

evidence.anchor: unsupervised learning to become far more important
evidence.quote: Although we have not focused on it in this Review, we expect unsupervised learning to become far more important in the longer term.
